note: Identical camera records are reused byte-for-byte by the reference and candidate captures. Positions and targets are authored inspection viewpoints in uncalibrated design units; the camera is the InspectionCamera of each instantiated scene. bench_close and wider_scene are the required comparable pair; bench_oblique adds a second bench angle and plinth_check shows that the shared stone crop on the statue plinth is unchanged.

views.description: required close bench view, looking at the seat/back from the south
oblique bench view for legs, bollards and plinth separation
required wider scene view: bench, tree line, boundary and sky
statue plinth close view; it keeps the reference stone crop in both scenes
